titleEn: Law on Kidnapping, Trafficking, and Exploitation of Human Persons

articles.en: The abduction of persons for sale or for prostitution, and the trafficking of persons, whether inside or outside the territory of the Kingdom of Cambodia, are strictly prohibited.

.
Instigators and persons who attempt to commit the offences set out in Article 4 and Article 5 shall be liable to the same penalties as the principal offender.

- Any person who opens a place for the commission of debauchery or other obscene acts shall be liable to imprisonment from [number illegible] years to 5 years and to a fine from 5,000,000 riels (five million riels) to
30,000,000 riels (thirty million riels). In the case of recidivism, the penalty shall be doubled.
Article 4.- Any person who has committed an act of debauchery against a minor under 15 years of age, whether or not that minor consented, or who has bought the child from another person or from a procurer, shall be liable to imprisonment from
[number illegible] years to 20 years. In the case of recidivism, the maximum penalty shall be applied.
The court may additionally impose, as supplementary penalties, deprivation of civic rights and a prohibition on residence.
Chapter 5 Final provisions

- Detailed instructions for the implementation of this Law shall be determined by sub-decree.
Article 10.- Any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.
This Law was adopted by the National Assembly of the Kingdom of Cambodia on [day illegible] January 1996 at its
5th session of the 1st legislature.
Phnom Penh, [day illegible] January 1996
